judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, working implementation that satisfies every acceptance criterion in the issue. Like the reference, it renames the `afterModelResponse` hook parameter to `totalUsage` and sums `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, and `totalTokens` across all reporting rounds while preserving `undefined` when no round reports usage. The candidate goes one step further than the reference on the fourth acceptance criterion ('The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous') by introducing a documented `TurnUsage = UsageMetadata` type alias in `src/types/ai.ts`. The main differences from the reference are placing the new tests in a separate `chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` file (plus leaving a `.lore/dod.md` artifact) rather than adding them directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and placing the `afterModelResponse` spec update under the 'Measured semantics' section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` without also updating `CLAUDE.md` and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
